subject: Eval plan gating & timeline sync — Acme Health MAP (week 3)
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Eval plan gating & timeline sync — Acme Health MAP (week 3)

Hi Claire / Acme team,

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick follow-up from our MAP checkpoint: attached is the current MAP workbook (MAP_v1.xlsx) and the evaluation criteria doc (Eval_Criteria.md). Key items for this week's sync: 

- Acceptance gating: final acceptance includes (a) passing the anomaly detection eval at >= 92% F1 on the seeded dataset, (b) response latency <= 420ms p95 in your dev environment, and (c) SOC2 evidence for security/procurement.
- Timeline: we are on the Week 3 runway toward a targeted pilot acceptance by 2026-12-03; if SOC2 / DPA issues push beyond next week we should discuss a short timeline adjustment.
- Demo: proposing a joint live runthrough of the scripted scenarios on Tue Nov 24 at 10:00 PT. Can you confirm?

Action owners (provisional):
- Ben: compile SOC2 artifacts + evidence package
- Marissa: coordinate dataset access and short anonymization runbook
- Karthik: produce quantization/throughput recommendation for your dev hardware
- Evelyn: schedule the demo and update MAP workbook with gated dates

Please flag any blockers on your side so we can triage in tomorrow's ops call.

Attachments: [Attachment: MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)], [Attachment: Eval_Criteria.md (text/markdown)]

Thanks,
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Claire Huang <claire.huang@acmehealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-17T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Eval plan gating & timeline sync — Acme Health MAP (week 3)

Thanks Evelyn — quick notes: 

- Procurement asked for clarification: we require SOC2 Type II report and a signed DPA before any test data leaves our environment. Can you confirm Redwood can provide the SOC2 package and a DPA template this week?
- On data residency: for HIPAA-adjacent workflows we prefer to run the evaluation in our VPC. Is there an on-prem/VPC flow for the POC? If not, procurement will need extra sign-offs and that will push the timeline.
- Regarding acceptance criteria: the team is aligned on the anomaly detection F1 target but wants a short list of canonical prompts you will run so we can validate coverage.

I copied procurement to start the paperwork. If SOC2 + DPA can be confirmed by EOD Friday (11/19), we'll keep the current acceptance target. If not, expect a 1–2 week slip.

On the demo: Tue Nov 24 at 10:00 PT should work; I'll confirm with our infra lead once procurement is happy.

Claire
Claire Huang
Sr. Director of Data Platforms | Acme Health
claire.huang@acmehealth.com

Subject: Re: Eval plan gating & timeline sync — Acme Health MAP (week 3)

Claire — thanks for the prompt. Quick update on owners and ETAs so we have clear commitments for procurement and the MAP: 

Action items (owner -> ETA):
1) SOC2 evidence package (Ben) -> 2026-11-19 EOD. I'll include the SOC2 Type II report, our security controls summary, and the artifact index.
2) DPA draft (Legal/Sales Ops) (Evelyn + Legal) -> draft to Acme procurement by 2026-11-19 midday.
3) VPC/Private deployment runbook & checklist (Karthik) -> 2026-11-20. Includes limited on-prem guidance and network requirements.
4) Canonical prompt list & scripted scenarios (Marissa) -> 2026-11-19 morning. Will include the exact prompt bank we'll run during the demo.
5) Demo scheduling (Evelyn) -> finalize invite once SOC2/DPA confirmed.

Notes on blockers: 
- If procurement requires full on-prem (air-gapped) evaluation rather than VPC, we'll need to spin up an on-prem plan which will add ~2 weeks. Karthik's runbook will indicate whether a VPC-hosted POC meets their data residency constraints.
- There's one engineering constraint on the latency target: our quantized v2 path hits ~380ms p95 on equivalent GPUS in our infra tests; if Acme runs on significantly older hardware we may need to tweak sequence lengths or batching. Karthik will include recommended profiles.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2_pack.zip (application/zip)]

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
